hwopt.config.title: HWOPT Config
hwopt.config.tickCulling.desc: Skip entity ticking when behind walls to reduce CPU usage
hwopt.config.solidLeaves.desc: Treat leaves as solid blocks for occlusion culling checks
hwopt.config.tracingDistance.desc: Maximum distance (blocks) for entity occlusion tracing
hwopt.config.sleepDelay.desc: Sleep delay between culling task iterations (0 = no sleep)
hwopt.config.hitboxLimit.desc: Skip entities with bounding box larger than this value
hwopt.config.captureRate.desc: Capture entities for culling every N ticks
hwopt.config.skipEntityCulling.desc: Completely skip entity culling (render all entities)
hwopt.config.skipBlockEntityCulling.desc: Completely skip block entity culling (render all block entities)
hwopt.config.forceDisplayCulling.desc: Force culling for Display entities with zero-sized bounding box
hwopt.config.debugMode.desc: Use player eye position instead of camera for culling checks
hwopt.config.asyncParticleTick.desc: Tick particles on a separate thread pool to reduce main-thread load
hwopt.config.particleLightCache.desc: Cache particle light coordinates to avoid repeated chunk lookups on each frame
hwopt.config.particleLimit.desc: Maximum number of particles per particle type group
hwopt.config.removeIfMissedTick.desc: Remove particles that were not ticked in the async pool (e.g. due to thread saturation)
hwopt.config.parallelQueueRemoval.desc: Use multiple threads when removing dead particles from queues
hwopt.config.parallelQueueEviction.desc: Run eviction callbacks in parallel during queue removal
hwopt.config.dccEnabled.desc: Enable delayed chunk caching to reduce chunk loading churn near view distance edges
hwopt.config.netFlushMs.desc: Time window for batching packets before sending
hwopt.config.netMaxBytes.desc: Flush batch when accumulated bytes exceed this value
hwopt.config.netMaxCount.desc: Flush batch when packet count exceeds this value
hwopt.config.netMaxPacketSize.desc: Drop packets larger than this limit
hwopt.config.dccCacheTimeout.desc: Time before a cached chunk entry expires
hwopt.config.dccCacheDistance.desc: Extra distance to keep chunks cached beyond view radius
hwopt.config.dccCacheSizeLimit.desc: Maximum cached chunks before oldest entries are evicted
hwopt.config.dccBufferDistance.desc: Extra buffer beyond view distance for pre-loading chunks
hwopt.configuration.debug.logChunkGen.to: Print chunk generation timing stats to chat
hwopt.configuration.debug.logChunkGenInt: Print stats every N chunks (0 = only at end of burst)
hwopt.configuration.world.spawnAtVillage: Move world spawn to the nearest village
